description: NaO₂Br crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.70 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Br atom to form corner-sharing ONa₃Br tetrahedra. The O-Br bond length is 1.77 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Br atom. The O-Br bond length is 1.76 Å. Br is bonded in a water-like geometry to two O atoms.
